quantification_method: For each protein and each sample, the protein log2 abundance is the median of the log2-transformed intensities of all peptides uniquely matched to that protein. Peptides not observed in a sample (missing intensity) are naturally excluded from that sample's median; if no peptide is observed for a protein in a sample, the value is imputed with the protein's median across its observed samples.
shared_peptide_handling: Excluded: peptides whose Proteins field listed more than one protein ID (semicolon-separated) were not assigned to any single protein and were omitted from quantification.
